name: Biscuit
brief: A golden-brown floppy-eared pixel-art puppy with a cream muzzle and chest and a terracotta collar. Eight poses per animation for resting, typing, requesting input, failure, and celebrating.
reference: reference.png extracted without redrawing from sources/ready.png, first cell

prompts.ready:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite sheet for a small desktop pet.
Create a charming compact golden-brown floppy-eared puppy named Biscuit, a nonhuman four-legged dog, in clean hand-drawn pixel art. Cream muzzle and chest, dark brown nose and eyes, caramel floppy ears, tiny muted terracotta collar, short wagging tail. Large readable head, squat little paws. No clothing, no accessories except collar. Flat limited warm palette, crisp blocky pixels, a simple dark-brown one-pixel outline. Front three-quarter view facing slightly right, full body. Consistent character identity in every frame.
Produce exactly EIGHT animation frames in a perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, output 1024 x 512 pixels, each cell exactly 256 x 256. Cells fill the sheet edge to edge without margins or gutters. Chronological left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Actual transparent background, including the spaces between legs. No text, numbers, cell borders, grids, checkerboard, shadows, scenery, glows, watermark.
Animation: calm READY loop, puppy sitting contentedly and breathing gently, short tail wag and one blink. Frame 1 neutral eyes open and tail relaxed; 2 inhale begins tail sweeps right; 3 inhale eyes open tail right; 4 blink halfway; 5 blink closed; 6 eyes reopen tail left; 7 exhale; 8 returns close to neutral for smooth looping into frame 1. Every cell contains the same dog at the same size, angle, and ground anchor. Minimal pose changes, not eight unrelated dog drawings.
Geometry: in each 256px cell, body centered at x=128; paws touch y=224, tips of ears/head near y=80. Keep all artwork inside x=48..208 and y=64..228. Render as if drawn on a 64x64 pixel grid enlarged exactly 4x, with crisp square pixel clusters. Stable paws and body anchor across frames; only chest, eyelids and tail move. No cropping or touching cell edges. The first frame must be a complete useful still pose.
prompts.typing:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art animation sheet for the T3 Pet desktop app.
Image 1 is the canonical Biscuit identity reference. Reproduce this exact golden-brown puppy: same big head, floppy caramel ears, cream muzzle/chest/forehead tuft, dark brown outline and nose, round eyes, terracotta collar, squat paws and tail. Same pixel-art texture and palette, same three-quarter view facing slightly right, same size. Draw a coherent chronological animation, not separate redesigns.
Exactly EIGHT frames in FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows. Target sheet 1024 x 512, cell 256 x 256, no gutters or outer margins. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every cell transparent around the full character and inside gaps, no shadows or background. Do not paint a checkerboard. No text, numbers, borders, watermarks, symbols, sparkles, camera changes or extra limbs.
Keep the same registration in every cell: puppy centered at x=128; resting paws at y=240; top of resting head around y=54; character width around 160 pixels. Keep each frame inside its own cell with clear transparent padding. Preserve body scale and ground anchor, except the explicitly requested jump displacement. First frame must be a useful still pose for this state. Last frame must return towards frame one for seamless looping.
Animation WORKING / TYPING. The same puppy is seated behind a small plain dark warm-gray open laptop, its front paws resting on the keyboard in frame one. Laptop is centered in front of the dog's lower chest and stays completely fixed in every frame. Dog's face and collar visible above it, tail visible beside it. No desk, no text on screen. Eight frames: 1 both paws on keyboard looking focused, 2 left paw slightly raised, 3 left paw presses, 4 right paw slightly raised, 5 right paw presses with small blink, 6 left paw slightly raised, 7 left paw presses eyes open, 8 both paws approach first pose. Tiny paw motion and tail wag, dog body and laptop stay fixed. Collar and head stay at reference height. Full paws and laptop visible.
